title: Kazhinju
dek: A witch whose possessive claim over Bogdan turns an ingredient-gathering mission into violence, confession and a chance to help him.

facts.Associated place: Graveyard grove west of Tabitha’s home

body:
Tabitha warns that Kazhinju guards the grove, dislikes strangers and resents Bogdan’s marriage. The expedition meets her near the graveyard while gathering ingredients for him.

28 September · the confrontation

On hearing Tabitha’s name, Kazhinju becomes violent and claims Bogdan belongs to her. Vylaris prevents a strike against the witch and continues questioning her. She says she gave Bogdan the disease because she wanted to take him with her, while denying knowledge of events in Pristinia.

After her composure breaks, she lets the party take what is needed and guides the harvest. That choice helps deliver the remedy’s ingredients. It does not establish a general reconciliation with Tabitha, a cure for Bogdan or responsibility for every reported outbreak of fever.
